decisions.original: An 18-year-old boy named George Jr. drove through his hometown on his way home for dinner. But as he was driving, George Jr. could not help but feel like he was really dreading actually getting there. So George Jr. was a very smart kid, but he also got distracted really easily, and because of that he really had not pursued anything all that seriously.
decisions.translation: 18-річний хлопчик, на ім'я __GLOS__000_, їхав через свою _GLOS_001 **у дорозі додому на вечерю. Отже, __GLOS_000__ був дуже розумною дитиною, але також він відволікався дуже легко, і тому він насправді не займався чимось настільки серйозним.

decisions.original: That is except for cars. And at that point his father actually bought him a small Italian car called a Fiat, but his father, despite being the one who literally gave him the Fiat, he just didn't get his son's obsession with cars.
decisions.translation: І в цей момент його батько купив йому маленьку італійську машину, яка називається 'Фіат, але його батько, незважаючи на те, що він був тим, хто дав йому "Фіат," він не отримав одержимості сина автомобілями.

decisions.original: Like why aren't you able to take that focus and apply it to other things that will get you a real job?
decisions.translation: Наприклад, чому ти не можеш зосередити свою увагу на інших речах, які принесуть тобі справжню роботу?

decisions.original: And so basically every dinner these days it became this huge argument between father and son. And so George, he came to this intersection where it was right near his home and he begins making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went black.
decisions.translation: Отже, Джордж прийшов на цей перетин, де він був прямо біля свого дому, і почав робити поворот, коли він почув цей гучний звук, а потім все потемніло.

decisions.original: Two weeks later George Jr. was laying in a hospital bed in the intensive care unit at the local hospital. So two weeks earlier when George was making that turn and then something happened, well what it was is another car came speeding down the road and smashed into George's car so hard that George Jr. was ejected from the car but he had survived.
decisions.translation: Через два тижні Джордж Джер. прокладався в стаціонарному комплексі в місцевій лікарні. Так два тижні раніше, коли Джордж зробив це, а потім щось відбулося, і що це був ще один автомобіль приступив до дороги і розім'явся в машину Джорджа так важко, що Джордж Джр. був виведений з автомобіля, але він пережили.

So George Jr. had decided that he really didn't want to race cars anymore.

decisions.original: Now George Jr. walked over to the podium to take some photos of the winning driver but as he walked over there this middle-aged man came up beside him and just asked George Jr. about his photography and then at some point the man actually formally introduced himself as Haskell Wexler and he said that he was actually a cinematographer in Hollywood and George Jr. told Haskell about how he had recently applied to USC to try to get into their cinematography program and when Haskell heard this he said George I know people at USC let me make some calls and sure enough not long after this fateful meeting George Jr. would receive an acceptance letter from USC's film school but this moment in George Jr.'s life did not just alter George's life forever it also would go on to completely alter cinema in general forever because about 13 years later George Jr. would go on to create one of the most groundbreaking films in history his movie would go on to become part of the most successful movie franchise of all time George Jr. is better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise was Star Wars George Jr. is better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise was Star Wars
